name: Storage Nexus
description: Drawers, a simple storage network, cross-dimensional tablets and links, Ender IO-style item and fluid conduits, and all-in-one tools (AIOTs) that keep the enchantments of the five tools they are made from. Also includes Nexus Essentials: no creeper/ghast block damage, endermen leave blocks alone, an item and XP magnet with its own trinket slot, a wings slot so an elytra and chestplate can be worn together, protection enchantments on elytra, netherite counts as gold for piglins, a bedrock-breaking elixir, picking up mobs as items, Fortune on ancient debris, and a 1-block iron farm.
